carpet.rule.fakePlayerTpp.name: Fake Player Pearl Station TP
carpet.rule.fakePlayerTpp.desc: Use fake players to trigger pearl teleport stations; enables the /tppset station manager and the /tpp teleport command
carpet.rule.fakePlayerNameSuggestions.de: Customize the fake player names suggested by the /player command, separated by ','
carpet.rule.fakePlayerSkinMode.name: Fake Player Skin Mode
carpet.rule.fakePlayerSkinMode.desc: Set fake player skins with the skinrestorer dependency: default=keep as-is; summon=use the summoner's skin; same_skin=use the skin of the player set in fakePlayerSkinSet
carpet.rule.fakePlayerSkinSet.name: Fake Player Uniform Skin
carpet.rule.fakePlayerSkinSet.desc: When fakePlayerSkinMode is same_skin, the player name whose skin is used for fake players
carpet.rule.fixXaeroLib.name: XaeroLib Compatibility Patch
carpet.rule.fixXaeroLib.desc: Fix fake player data loss issue with newer Xaero versions when used with LuckPerms
carpet.rule.fixBlueMap.name: BlueMap Compatibility Patch
carpet.rule.fixBlueMap.desc: Fix fake players not triggering Fabric API connection events, causing mods like BlueMap to fail tracking fake player join/leave
carpet.rule.invisibleInTallGrass.name: Invisible in Tall Grass
carpet.rule.invisibleInTallGrass.desc: Players become invisible when their head is in tall grass
carpet.rule.playerHat.name: Player Hat
carpet.rule.playerHat.desc: Allow players to wear items on their head, adds /hat command. Totem of Undying on head can trigger death protection
carpet.rule.ridingPlayers.name: Riding Players
carpet.rule.ridingPlayers.desc: When holding Totem of Undying in main hand, can ride other players
carpet.rule.pickupPlayers.name: Pickup Players
carpet.rule.pickupPlayers.desc: When holding Totem of Undying in main hand + Golden Carrot in offhand, can pick up other players (let them ride on you)
carpet.rule.ridingPlayersStackLimit.name: Riding & Picking Max Limit
carpet.rule.ridingPlayersStackLimit.desc: Maximum number of players that can be stacked when riding or picking up (shared limit)
carpet.rule.ridingPlayersAutoDismount.de: When the player's game mode changes, dismount passengers on head
Client-side required: allows interacting with blocks/entities while having passengers on head
carpet.rule.sleepingDuringTheDay.name: Daydream
carpet.rule.sleepingDuringTheDay.desc: Allow players to sleep during the day, switches to night after sleeping (referenced from PCA)
carpet.rule.unicodeArgumentsSupport.name: Unicode Argument Support
carpet.rule.unicodeArgumentsSupport.desc: Allow non-ASCII characters (Chinese, Japanese, Korean, etc.) in command arguments, can be used to summon fake players with Chinese names (ported from YACA)
carpet.rule.betterSnowball.name: Better Snowball
carpet.rule.betterSnowball.desc: Stone hidden in snow. Allows snowballs to deal knockback and damage to players
carpet.rule.fakePlayerDropAll.name: Fake Player Continuous Drop
carpet.rule.fakePlayerDropAll.desc: Adds a dropall sub-command to /player <name> that drops the fake player's whole inventory at a configured pace
carpet.rule.fakePlayerSendto.name: Fake Player Inventory Link
carpet.rule.fakePlayerSendto.desc: Adds a sendto sub-command to /player <name> creating one-way inventory item flow between fake players (one stack per trigger, default every tick, round-robin across targets, source buffers when a target is full) with adjustable pace; sendto stop removes all links, links do not survive restarts
carpet.rule.playerScale.name: Player Scale
carpet.rule.playerScale.desc: Registers the minecraft:scale attribute for Player and enables /scale set|reset|info; value only needs to be greater than 0, bounded by playerScaleMin/Max. false=hide command; self=adjust self only; true=adjust self, admins adjust anyone; everyone=anyone adjusts anyone. FOV compensation requires client install
carpet.rule.playerScaleMin.name: Player Scale Min
carpet.rule.playerScaleMin.desc: Minimum scale value all players can set via /scale set; admins can adjust the bound by changing this rule
carpet.rule.playerScaleMax.name: Player Scale Max
carpet.rule.playerScaleMax.desc: Maximum scale value all players can set via /scale set; admins can adjust the bound by changing this rule
carpet.rule.playerScalePhysics.name: Realistic Player Scale
carpet.rule.playerScalePhysics.desc: Player physics scale with size (requires playerScale): true=gentle, key attributes scale with sqrt(scale); safety=gentle + small-size floors (speed/gravity 0.3x, jump/step/interaction/fall 0.5x, recommended); strict=strictly proportional, jump height proportional to size. Details in the rules doc
carpet.rule.playerScaleLinkedEntities.de: Living entities spawned directly by a player using an item inherit the player's size snapshot (armor stands, spawn-egg mobs, built iron/snow/copper golems; ratios stack with existing modifiers such as babies). Living entities from the player's hand only; dispensers/spawners and non-living entities are not linked
carpet.rule.peacefulPlayers.name: Peaceful Players
carpet.rule.peacefulPlayers.desc: Enables /pvp to toggle PVP per player: two-way protection, self-damage unaffected, blocked attacks play a notice sound. false=hide command; self=adjust self only; true=admins adjust anyone; everyone=anyone adjusts anyone; /pvp on|off @a is a server-wide switch (admin-only), per-player toggles are locked while the global switch is off, states persist across restarts
carpet.rule.moreEndCrystalTypes.name: More End Crystal Types
carpet.rule.moreEndCrystalTypes.desc: Allows placing end crystals on crying obsidian: true=places a normal (vulnerable) crystal; invulnerable=places an invulnerable one (Invulnerable=1 with the bottom slab shown, identical to the invulnerable crystal obtainable by pushing it off a pillar mid dragon resurrection). In both modes the crystal's beam points to the fixed position (0,128,0). Crystals placed on obsidian/bedrock are unaffected
carpet.rule.fixEndCrystalSync.name: Fix End Crystal Sync
carpet.rule.fixEndCrystalSync.desc: Fixes client-side position desync when end crystals are pushed by pistons. Cause: vanilla never streams position updates for end crystals and both sides simulate piston pushes independently, so any divergence never self-corrects (only a relog/restart recovers). When enabled, the server forces the vanilla position-sync branch whenever a tracked crystal's position changes, realigning clients within 1 tick; the spawn-order race on relogin is covered too
